evals.prompt: the wiki screenshots show real client names and staff emails — refresh the next-pms wiki with privacy-safe screenshots seeded on fake data.
evals.expected_output: The privacy-safe pipeline runs before any capture: recon reads the app's API/query code to classify each view's isolation class (USER-SCOPED / USER-PERMISSION / UI-FILTER / LEAKS-ALL); a coherent fictional 'family' (people in a reports-to hierarchy -> customers -> projects -> tasks -> timesheets -> allocations -> billing) is seeded via the chrome-devtools MCP browser using evaluate_script + frappe.client.insert as Administrator (never scripted curl, which the classifier blocks), with each doctype live-meta-checked and every record logged to a teardown manifest; isolation is verified by logging in as each fictional user; screenshots are re-captured at 1440x900 dpr=1 on the family and re-annotated (coords re-tuned for the shifted layout); a blocking privacy scan clears every image and caption of real client/staff/financial data; and the result is packaged as a private preview, not a public push. LEAKS-ALL aggregates that can't be scoped are deferred and documented in prose.

evals.prompt: before I seed demo data on the shared staging site, which Next PMS views can actually be isolated to a fake-data family and which will leak the whole site?
evals.expected_output: A per-view isolation map derived from reading the app's API/query code, classifying each documented view as USER-SCOPED (capture as a fictional user), USER-PERMISSION (add a User Permission, heeding the blank-link bypass), UI-FILTER (apply the family filter), or LEAKS-ALL (no lever -> clean instance or defer). Calls out the Frappe traps: no company-based scoping; a Customer User Permission does not hide blank-customer records (Strict User Permissions is site-wide/risky); Tasks are bounded by readable Projects not Customer; Timesheet Manager/User read timesheets with ignore_permissions so Team/Project Timesheet need the UI filter; dashboard aggregate widgets (at-risk counts, members-without-allocation, utilisation heatmap, Leadership KPIs) leak the whole site and need a clean instance.
